title: diphyes inversa
intro: Diphyes inversa, commonly known as the "Twin Flower", is a plant species with unique, twinned flowers. The health benefits of Diphyes inversa include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate coughing, promote the removal of mucus, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Diphyes inversa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
